description: This file defines the EmployeeEventService class, which provides methods to manage employee events such as saving, updating, and retrieving them within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the EmployeeEventDao for database operations and relies on traits for user role management and date/time helpers.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee events, including creating, updating, and retrieving event records, with role management and datetime helpers.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeEventDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeEvent object to the database.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an EmployeeEvent with provided details and current user info.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvents based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the current user or 'System' if not available.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an 'employee added' event.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an 'employee personal details updated' event.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an 'employee job details updated' event.
